 Gold Silver Price October 23, 2026: Gold prices continued to decline on October 23, 2026, with notable reductions at major jewellers. Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, and Kalyan Jewellers lowered their 22k gold rates significantly. Here is a look at 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online ​Gold rate today​ Gold prices continued slipping on Friday, October 23, 2026, with major jewellers such as Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas and Kalyan Jewellers lowering their 22-carat gold rates compared with previous day prices. Tanishq’s 22k gold price, meanwhile, was unchanged till the time of writing this article. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) is also yet to reveal its gold and silver jewellery’s indicative prices today.
Gold prices can vary across jewellers and cities due to factors like demand and supply, local taxes, making charges, etc. So, buyers should check the latest gold and silver rates before making a purchase.

 Gold outlook
Mr. Prithviraj Kothari, Managing Director at RiddiSiddhi Bullions Ltd., President of IBJA says "Gold and silver are heading for their steepest weekly fall in over four months. Oil jumped about 4% to a five-month high after Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, strengthening expectations that the Fed will keep rates higher for longer. Markets await the October 27–28 Fed meeting and next week’s PCE data. Gold has broken $4,000 (₹1,42,000) and may slip to $3,950 (~ ₹1,40,000), while silver, below $54.5 (~ ₹2,00,000), could test $50 (~ ₹1,80,000–1,85,000). Both metals are building a strong base over the medium term, with a 10–15% rebound expected. Holding above $4,200 for gold and $62 for silver would revive the uptrend."
 Gold and silver rates today (Friday, October 23, 2026)
Here is a look at 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. Also have a look at the IBJA’s 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k and 14k indicative gold jewellery rates and the 999-purity silver jewellery indicative price today.

As of October 23, 2026, Tanishq's price of 22k gold jewellery is Rs 13,100 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On October 22, 2026, the same variety of gold at Tanishq was priced at Rs 13,275 per gram.

As of October 23, 2026, Malabar Gold & Diamonds' 22k gold jewellery price is Rs 13,060 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On October 22, 2026, the 22k gold rate at the same brand was Rs 13,235 per gram.
